svg.text: Fourier Decomposition of a Complex Periodic Wave
f(t) = Σ Aₙ sin(nωt + φₙ) = A₁sin(ωt+φ₁) + A₂sin(2ωt+φ₂) + A₃sin(3ωt+φ₃) + ... + A₇sin(7ωt+φ₇)

g.text: Animation: Each harmonic oscillates at its frequency (f, 2f, ..., 7f)
Base period T=4s for fundamental; higher harmonics scale proportionally
